title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・誕生、そして

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober has won. She and Air Groove praise each other on a job well done and vow to battle again on an even grander stage one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Mejiro Dober proudly declares to the crowd that she is the harbinger of a new Mejiro era.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone celebrates the light Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Bright now shine as symbolic of the new Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, their era has only just begun. The luminous paths Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Bright walk are far from having reached their ends.
